# beszel_user (Data Source)

Looks up a single existing Beszel user by ID or email.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "beszel_user" "example" {
  email = "alerts@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Email address. Exactly one of id or email must be set.
- `id` (String) PocketBase record ID of the user. Exactly one of id or email must be set.

### Read-Only

- `role` (String) One of user, admin, or readonly.
- `username` (String) Auto-generated username.
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether the account is marked verified.
